text:
diane: Heads-up — Magnetix offered a short early-access window for their new MX-1U nodes. We need to lock NDA + bench plan by EOD so ops can schedule shipping.

akshay: Which lab and dates?

diane: They can ship two-week access starting Mon 2026-04-13 to our SJC lab. Vendor link + NDA: https://secure/magnetix/nda (internal).

maria: We need a masking plan for customer-like datasets. No raw PII on vendor hardware. I'll prepare synthetic swaps.

josh: For the bench harness I'll run the usual workload set. Proposed run command:```
./run_bench --model=redwood-3b --seq=2048 --iters=100 --collect=power,temp,latency
```Sample log snippet:
[2026-04-10 09:12:05] RUN start model=redwood-3b seq=2048 iter=1 temp=68C power=320W
[2026-04-10 09:12:20] RUN done iter=100 avg_latency=42.1ms

lab-scheduler: Rack slots reserved: rack-42U slots 6-8. PDUs staged, network uplink configured. Cooling baseline verified.

magnetix_onboard: MagnetixOps (vendor) here — shipping ETA Wed 2026-04-15. Devices: MX-00123, MX-00124, MX-00125. We signed NDA on 2026-04-10.

lina: Marketplace team: we need updated SKU mapping and images before any public listing. I'll ping @product for final assets.

akshay: Telemetry requirement: 1s granularity for GPU temp and power, per-GPU and aggregated per-node. Can magnetix export OTLP?

diane: Yes — they can stream OTLP. Endpoint we'll use: otel.redwood.internal:55680. We'll tag streams by device serial.

josh: Also add kernel requirement to runbook: linux-5.10 + magnetix-therm v2 driver. Container image will include ncv2/harness:magnetix-2026-04.

maria: Reminder: vendor NDA forbids publishing raw micro-bench numbers. We can publish relative perf deltas vs our in-house baseline with margin. Will draft the allowed messaging doc.

diane: Checklist (quick):
1) NDA signed by both sides
2) Lab + rack booked
3) Telemetry pipeline wired to OTEL endpoint
4) Bench harness + container ready
5) Masked datasets prepared and verified
6) Public messaging constraints doc approved by legal/vendor

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you own an item.

magnetix_onboard: NDA signed by Magnetix legal 2026-04-10.

akshay: I'll own telemetry wiring and stream verification.

josh: I'll own harness + container, pushing draft to https://git.internal/redwood/partners/magnetix/bench (branch: magnetix-2026).

maria: I'll own data masking and prompts. Question: do we need a host-side power limiter? Suggest cap at 9kW per rack during runs.

lab-scheduler: PDU cap set at 9kW per rack. Thermal baseline testing passed with room delta +6C under load.

diane: Product/marketing — please DO NOT draft any joint announcement until partner signoff on messaging and privacy (per NDA). @lina @akshay please coordinate partner comms call.

lina: Scheduling partner comms call for Fri 10am PST. Will send calendar invite and draft agenda.

diane: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after first soak day. :raised_hands:

josh: Quick note — I'll include an automated regression check that fails the job if avg_latency increases >10% vs baseline.

maria: Added: eval prompts list v1 and mask schema uploaded to the partner folder.

akshay: Telemetry smoke passed. OTLP traces + metrics visible in staging console.

lab-scheduler: Vendor will arrive on site Wed morning for handoff. Access badges pending. Ops will coordinate.

diane: Closing thread — follow-ups are assigned in the checklist. If anything blocks shipping, escalate to @ops-director.
